synopsis: NVIDIA NuRec reconstructs scenes from recordings using Gaussian splatting and is described as supporting domain-neutral reconstruction from logs [f15954, f9163]. It is integrated with Isaac Sim and CARLA 0.9.16; Isaac Sim provides NuRec-based neural rendering, while CARLA 0.9.16 added NuRec support [f8609, f8479, f8467]. The tooling inventory lists an open-core license, free internal use, and a latest release found dated 2025 to 2026 [f9162, f9165, f9166]. The glossary cautions that NuRec and related methods reconstruct appearance from logs but struggle with changes in sensor viewpoint [f16004]. Whether such reconstructions can serve as test evidence rather than training data remains uncertain, and the chapter's on-road assessment says learned reconstruction has not eliminated the need for application-specific credibility evidence [f9355, f9358].

relations.note: Both identify Isaac Sim and CARLA 0.9.16 as NuRec integration interfaces.
